desc: 无刷动力一机多用套图：圆徽功能矩阵、多材质实钻四宫格、电机对比、续航信息图与握感微距
name: 无刷一机多用冲击锂电钻款

shots.intent: 暗调金属斜台上立式整机，三枚黄标签锁定核心卖点，一秒建立动力印象赢取点击
shots.textZone: left 40% copy column: one bold white headline with a signal-yellow keyword highlight plus three stacked rounded signal-yellow tag pills; top-left corner stays clear without any logo

shots.intent: 圆形黄徽矩阵直给三大功能，用图标语言承接首图并坐实一机多用
shots.textZone: top center bold headline with signal-yellow keyword highlight; center row of three circular badges with short labels; bottom center short strapline

shots.intent: 木材、金属、瓷砖、家具四类实钻特写并排，证明多材质作业真实可用
shots.textZone: bottom label strip of each tile, one short white label per tile

shots.intent: 有刷与无刷电机剖视并列，把无刷动力优势讲成一眼可感知的差别
shots.textZone: top center bold headline; one label plus two short bullet lines per column; thin vertical divider between columns

shots.intent: 侧视整机加超大数字与电池图形，把续航焦虑转成可视化卖点
shots.textZone: three short claims separated by thin grey bars above the headline; yellow tag pill plus bold headline; oversized signal-yellow number beside the battery illustration; one short grey note line

shots.intent: 握柄软胶微距特写，证明久握不累的包胶做工与质感细节
shots.textZone: bottom label strip with one signal-yellow dot, one short white label and one grey note line

shots.intent: 黄色斜光收口呼应首图，用头条与行动按钮完成下单引导
shots.textZone: left side oversized signal-yellow offer headline with one white sub-line, plus one rounded signal-yellow CTA button with dark label

style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #1B1C1E studio backdrop with diagonal brushed-graphite step podiums and rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 info panels
style.iconSystem: filled circular signal-yellow #F7B500 feature badges with dark glyphs, thin-line white circle icons, rounded-rectangle label pills; consistent across the set
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool directional studio key at 5600K from the upper left, controlled metal speculars, soft contact shadows, dramatic falloff on dark sections
style.lockText: consistent industrial power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1C1E background, dark graphite panel #2A2D31, pure white #FFFFFF text and one signal-yellow accent #F7B500; neutral-cool directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in white with signal-yellow keyword highlights on dark panels; consistent filled circular signal-yellow feature badges, thin-line white circle icons and rounded-rectangle label pills; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; clean balanced framing with clear inner padding inside info panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; annotations use small signal-yellow dots with thin leader lines; contact shadow always present, no floating product
style.surfaceSystem: brushed graphite-metal step podiums; warm wood, brushed steel, glazed tile and furniture-panel job-site surfaces inside material tiles
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; white #FFFFFF headlines with signal-yellow #F7B500 keyword highlights on dark panels, thin grey caption strips and divider bars
